name: Describe Leads2
summary: Lists the lead fields that can be used to filter/search leads (for 'Get Leads by Filter Type'), with the allowed filter types for each.
whenToUse: Use this to learn which field to put in the 'Filter on' field of Get Leads by Filter Type — it shows every searchable field and its type.

response.description: Array of searchable field definitions: REST name, data type, and allowed filter types.

notes: Companion to 'Describe Leads' — that one lists all fields; this one lists which are searchable/filterable.
